places.name: Clara's ranch
places.note: Despondent July helps Clara tend Bob; she offers to raise Martin and to hire July, then comforts him after Elmira leaves.
places.location_hint: frame house by the Platte, about twenty miles from Ogallala, Nebraska

places.name: North Platte River
places.note: Cholo splashes out of it late at night returning to the corrals.

places.name: Ogallala
places.note: July returns to find Elmira gone; the doctor, delivering a baby at a whorehouse, says she left, and the livery man warns of Sioux to the east.

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: Clara says living there has made her blunt.

places.name: Fort Smith
places.note: July doubts he'll ever get Elmira back there and wonders if they've hired a new sheriff.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: July has always lived there and never thought of settling elsewhere.
